d.ko: Feed the Cups is a Roguelite multiplayer online cooperative game. Run a Drink Shop, stocking up, preparing ingredients, taking orders, crafting drinks, cleaning up, and checking equipment. Join your friends together!
d.en: Feed the Cups is a Roguelite multiplayer online cooperative game. Run a Drink Shop, stocking up, preparing ingredients, taking orders, crafting drinks, cleaning up, and checking equipment. Join your friends together!
d.zh: 《杯杯倒满》是一款带有肉鸽元素的合作游戏。模拟经营一家饮品店，从开店前的进货，备料，到开店时的点单、饮品制作、出货，结束营业之后还要打扫卫生，关闭设备等等。小心，错误太多可是会导致“压力”爆棚的！快来喊上朋友们一起做饮品吧~最多支持四人联机
